item.title: How to invest £1 a day and turn it into £15,000 over 20 years - and where to buy shares and ETFs fee-free
item.author: dailymail.co.uk
item.description: Cheapest for the global stock market is the Amundi Prime All Country World, with an annual charge of just 0.07 per cent. It is diversified across thousands of companies. If you prefer US firms, Vanguard's S&P 500 tracker, known as VUSA, has a similar charge. For a UK fund, Xtrackers has an ETF charging 0.5 per cent a year that tracks the top 100 British firms.
